name: Multi-Level Gaussian Caching Pipeline
definition: A hierarchical optimization framework that maintains multiple independent levels of Gaussian splats, each rasterized and optimized against cached reference radiance samples, to enable progressive refinement or accelerated training.
summary: Multi-Level Gaussian Caching Pipeline is a hierarchical optimization framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that decouples spatial details into pyramid levels, rasterizing each against cached reference radiance samples rather than ground truth images.
